# Icon Button

A button whose only label is an attribute, at a size a finger can hit.

In `library/components/icon-button/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the button** — `type=button` `aria-label`
- **the glyph** — `aria-hidden=true` `focusable=false`

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — native: it is a <button>

**States:** hover, focus-visible, disabled

## Goes wrong when

- no name at all, so it announces as a bare button
- the aria-label on the wrapper instead of on the button
- a visible word left out of the name (SC 2.5.3 Label in Name)
- shrink-wrapped to the glyph, under the 24px floor (SC 2.5.8)
- the SVG left in the name, which gives it a second and worse half

**API:** `AC.createIconButton(root) -> { refresh, resolveName, element, destroy }`

WCAG 1.1.1 2.5.3 2.5.8 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) · see also `button`, `tooltip`, `visually-hidden`
